name: com.ecanakli.janitor
description: Cleans up Tasks, Tweens, Coroutines & Events. UniTask work, DOTween tweens, coroutines, timers and event subscriptions are bound to an owner lifetime and stop when it is destroyed, disabled, cancelled or its scene unloads. Nothing outlives its owner.

samples.description: Core only: lifetimes, areas, tasks, timers, coroutines, owned events and the scene call. Needs com.unity.ugui.
Requires DOTween. Tweens bound to lifetimes, cancel modes and awaiting a tween.
Requires the Zenject integration to be active. Injected lifetimes, a categories service and SignalBus subscriptions.
